_description: Per-component presentation metadata consumed by jsonui-mcp-server. Augments attribute_definitions.json (which defines the raw attribute schema, including binding_direction per attribute) with human descriptions, aliases, platform availability, platform-specific implementation notes, and agent-facing rules. Edit this file to change what `lookup_component` / `search_components` / `lookup_attribute` return from the MCP.

_schema.interactive: boolean — REQUIRED on every type: whether a user can operate this component on its own (a control, an input, or a scrolling / embedding container). A tappable that holds one is not flattened into a single button for screen readers (shared/core/tap_accessibility.rb). Declared, never derived: Button, Radio and Web declare no two-way binding and are operable.

Embed.description: Embeds another screen as a region of this layout. The embedded screen owns its own ViewModel — independent from the parent VM.

swift.view: EmbedContainer wrapping the embedded screen's generated View (static) or DynamicView(jsonName:data:) (dynamic). @StateObject identity gives natural VM isolation.

kotlin.composable: EmbedContainer with per-slot ViewModelStoreOwner remembered against the layout id — required so that the same screen embedded twice gets two VM instances.

react.element: <EmbedContainer> rendering the embedded screen component. Hook closure scoping gives natural VM isolation.

rules: id is required on the Layout JSON Embed node and must be unique across the parent layout. On Android it doubles as the ViewModelStoreOwner key (remember(id)) — without it, multi-embed of the same screen would share a VM.
screen value is the layout JSON filename (snake_case, no extension), e.g. 'order_detail'. Codegen converts to the View class name; dynamic mode loads the layout JSON as-is.
The embedded screen requires no spec changes — the parent declares the embed in structure.embeds[]; the embedded VM stays as-is. Optional applyInitParams(_:) on the embedded VM consumes params.

params keys are camelCase at every level; values form a tree — intermediate nodes are literal objects only, leaves are scalar literals or @{varName} bindings (bindings are leaf-only; arrays unsupported). Bindings reactively propagate.
events keys follow on[A-Z]...; values must reference parent VM methods or eventHandlers. Embedded VMs emit via the lib-provided emit(name, payload) helper.

navigationMode 'delegate' (default): parent NavController/Router is shared; pop/dismiss/navigateBack are bounded at the embed and do not close it. 'isolated': the embed owns a private nav stack — push stays inside, pop stops at the embed stack root, the embed never closes itself. Requires SwiftJsonUI >= 10.5.0 / KotlinJsonUI >= 2.12.0 / EmbedContainer.tsx template v2.

Inside an isolated embed, present-type transitions (sheet/modal/dialog/dismiss) in the embedded screen's spec are a build error — iOS sheets present on the parent window, so visual containment cannot be guaranteed cross-platform.

Escape hatch from an isolated embed (full-screen transition, logout, session expiry): pass a parent-VM callback via params as a leaf binding (e.g. "onExitRequested": "@{handleChildExit}"). The child calls it; the parent executes the actual navigation. The child never navigates its host.

Isolated stack lifetime equals the embed container's identity: it survives Android configuration changes but resets when the embed leaves the view tree. Deep links address the host router only; OS back gestures / browser back are platform-delegated (Android: deepest non-empty isolated stack wins; web: browser back drives host history only).
